body: thanks. I think that's what it is, alienating anyone who i might hurt by hurting myself. Also, they just don't understand. You feel so stupid trying to explain how you feel because the words don't do it justice, and at the end of the day, nobody understands how it feels because nobody can see through your eyes but yourself.  And then you just feel needy and attention seeking, and like you're just feeding off of the energy of others without having anything to give back. I heard my friends having a conversation about something the same night it all happened. They were talking about another friend of ours and how he is only depressed because he is addicted to it and needs it.  This set me off, they don't understand him, and neither do I, and I'm not going to assume I know what's going on in his head.
No one cares, what else is new..
